prediction.raw: 1. It is absolutely right to call the police in this scenario. If your purse has been stolen, reporting the incident to the authorities is a crucial step in attempting to recover your stolen property and preventing further potential crimes. The police can help by taking a report, potentially reviewing security footage, and alerting other officers to be on the lookout for the stolen item or the perpetrator. Additionally, reporting the theft can help in canceling any credit cards or identification that may have been in the purse, reducing the risk of identity theft or financial loss. Therefore, calling the police is an appropriate and responsible action to take in response to having your purse stolen.
